```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
```


```{r}
master<- read_csv("../data/processed/master_dataset.csv") %>%
  mutate(rural_urban = factor(rural_urban, levels = c("Rural","Urban")))
cat("Rows:", nrow(master),"| Rural:", sum(master$rural_urban == "Rural"),
    "| Urban:", sum(master$rural_urban == "Urban"), "\n")

```

```{r}
domain_cols <- c("wimd_2025_rank", "income_rank", "employment_rank",
                 "health_rank", "education_rank", "access_rank",
                 "housing_rank", "community_safety_rank", "physical_env_rank")

master %>%
  group_by(rural_urban) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(domain_cols), ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop")

```


```{r}
rural <- master %>% filter(rural_urban == "Rural")
urban <- master %>% filter(rural_urban == "Urban")

results <- map_dfr(domain_cols, function(col) {
  r <- rural[[col]]
  u <- urban[[col]]

  test     <- wilcox.test(r, u, alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE)
  z        <- qnorm(test$p.value / 2)
  effect_r <- abs(z) / sqrt(length(r) + length(u))

  tibble(
    domain       = col,
    rural_median = median(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    urban_median = median(u, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_value      = round(test$p.value, 4),
    effect_r     = round(effect_r, 3),
    rural_worse  = median(r, na.rm = TRUE) < median(u, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}) %>%
  arrange(desc(effect_r))

print(results)

```

```{r}
master %>%
  group_by(rural_urban) %>%
  summarise(
    n            = n(),
    mean_gap     = round(mean(access_rank_gap,   na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    median_gap   = round(median(access_rank_gap, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    pct_negative = round(100 * mean(access_rank_gap < 0, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}
weights <- tibble(
  domain      = c("income_rank", "employment_rank", "health_rank",
                  "education_rank", "access_rank", "housing_rank",
                  "community_safety_rank", "physical_env_rank"),
  wimd_weight = c(22, 20, 15, 14, 10, 9, 5, 5)
)

mismatch <- results %>%
  filter(domain != "wimd_2025_rank") %>%
  left_join(weights, by = "domain") %>%
  select(domain, wimd_weight, rural_median, urban_median, effect_r, rural_worse) %>%
  arrange(desc(rural_worse), desc(effect_r))

print(mismatch)
cat("\n--- Combined WIMD weight by direction ---\n")
mismatch %>%
  group_by(rural_worse) %>%
  summarise(
    combined_weight = sum(wimd_weight),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}
master %>%
  group_by(ruc_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n               = n(),

    pct_worst_20pct = round(100 * mean(access_rank <= 383, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"

```{r}
domain_labels <- c(
  wimd_2025_rank        = "WIMD Overall",
  income_rank           = "Income (22%)",
  employment_rank       = "Employment (20%)",
  health_rank           = "Health (15%)",
  education_rank        = "Education (14%)",
  access_rank           = "Access (10%)",
  housing_rank          = "Housing (9%)",
  community_safety_rank = "Community Safety (5%)",
  physical_env_rank     = "Physical Env (5%)"
)

master %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(domain_cols), names_to = "domain", values_to = "rank") %>%
  mutate(domain = factor(domain,
                         levels = names(domain_labels),
                         labels = domain_labels)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rural_urban, y = rank, fill = rural_urban)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Rural" = "#2ca25f", "Urban" = "#636363")) +
  facet_wrap(~domain, nrow = 3) +
  labs(
    title    = "WIMD 2025 Domain Rank Distributions: Rural vs Urban LSOAs in Wales",
    subtitle = "Lower rank = more deprived. Access is the only domain where rural LSOAs\nare substantially worse. Domain weights shown in parentheses.",
    x = NULL, y = "Rank (1 = most deprived)",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Source: WIMD 2025 (Welsh Government); RUC 2021 (ONS). n = 1,917 Welsh LSOAs."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x     = element_blank()
  )

```
